verdict.rationale: Cake explicitly provides a separate 'My Cake Portal' for investors/employees to view their own holdings, distinct from the admin Company View, with admin-controlled visibility limits so investors don't see the full cap table; certificates and vesting details are accessible there without emailing the founder. Missing for 10: explicit evidence of proactive 'structured update' notifications/reports pushed to investors (beyond portal access) and independent/third-party corroboration of investor experience.
